label: Diagram 3.1
caption: Diagram 3.1
description:
This diagram, titled Diagram 3.1 Gallery floors with no alternative exit, is a three-dimensional perspective drawing of a two-level room layout. It shows a lower room with a green floor area and an upper gallery floor that overlooks it. A staircase connects the two levels, leading from the lower floor to the gallery. 

An arrow labelled 'Exit' points from the lower floor towards an opening in the wall. A dimension line shows the distance from the gallery edge to the staircase is '3m max.', while another dimension line indicates the distance from the gallery edge to the opposite wall is '7.5 max.'. A label points to the green floor area in the lower room, stating: 'Visible area to be at least 50% of floor area in lower room'.

The drawing includes several notes. Note 1 states the diagram does not apply where the gallery has an alternative escape route or an emergency escape window (if the gallery floor is not more than 4.5m above ground level). Note 2 states any cooking facilities in a room with a gallery must be enclosed with fire resisting construction or be remote from the gallery stair so as not to prejudice escape.
